note: Both sets extract only the 22% California lighting statistic and duplicate it, missing other page facts such as daylight harvesting and the two lighting system categories. Set A's second claim correctly binds 22% to residential lighting's share of household electrical use with the California/as-of-2010 conditions, while its first claim misstates the entity as household electrical use itself. Set B repeats the same misbinding and adds a third claim whose attribute ('average household electrical use') misrepresents the 22% as the use level rather than a share, so it carries more wrong claims overall.
